anupahacca.p: [Na+upahacca] (kri,vi) CL=1 (A) not destroyed; (B) not to be harmed; Do not destroy - do not destroy - (c) Excessive. See also (d) Do not destroy. Not taken out. anupahacca Anupahacca (Ti) [Na + Upahisa] (a) Not to be exceeded. (b) Not to be affected. See below.
a: အနုပဟစ္စ(ကြိ၊ဝိ)
